newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-W.Australia launches digital mineral list.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-W.Australia launches digital mineral list.

text.p: A comprehensive digital data list of all Western Australian mines and mineral deposits and their geographical co-ordinates was launched on Thursday by the state's Minerals and Energy Department.

Western Australia Mines Minister Kevin Minson said in a statement a published report, Record 1996/13, accurately plotted mineral deposits in Western Australia from the largest iron ore mine to the smallest rock quarry.

A disc accompanying the record provided current, readily accessible mineral resources information and associated data, including geographical co-ordinates, deposit or mine type and commercial ownership of projects, Minson said.
It included more than 5,000 individual sites and almost 8,000 resources, and the data package was a breakthrough in terms of portability and cost, he said.
He said the data would help in project generation, evaluation of mineral potential, strategic planning and in map production.

It would also be of use in modelling, a technque which involves overlaying a variety of data to build up a geological profile that forms the basis for regional project generation in the search for new mineral deposits, he said.

The data would come in two formats, as text files that could be imported into many software applications and as a MS ACCESS 2 database, and was available through the Mining Information Centre. "I believe it will become an indispensable item in the search for new prospects in WA," Minson said.
